set.body:
Parent instrument: bd-01M2TAAQNS7RCCBBM8WFFZF6ZZ. Tag reality-check-20261015. One bounded prerequisite: admit a complete all-participant historical gold-support freeze only after a separately committed, exact-revision pre-read declaration; no real gold/readout is performed by this implementation ticket.

Acceptance:
1. Canonical entry point checks committed plan/entry/log, independent pins, reader/producer/launch ancestry and executing code/assets before resolving/opening any data-root manifest, gold or captures. Missing/wrong declaration and changed executing arithmetic/config must fail before payload readers, with compiling mutation witnesses and passing controls.
2. Plan retains original17/two-arm identity through a pinned phase=read historical plan with all34 capture-manifest pins; gold is fixed at registered path/hash68cc307c19cfd429a3bd0eda84ee18d0152c87444d33a79246a7cd64d3763753/8343bytes. Support uses gold and frozen onsets only, all observations retained including clock/no-gold/missing-timing exclusions, without predictions or score-based eligibility.
3. Read exact owned snapshots of pinned manifest/gold, validate complete participant/input/unit joins and unchanged shared rule, then emit a local support artifact with both file-byte and canonical support digests, safe accounting and exposure provenance. Require a new nonsymlink output under admitted data root; retain failed progress. Do not open capture payloads/model/raw recall or compute a scientific comparison. Canonical all-participant digest must be independently committed before any later score comparison; old development-only support is inadmissible.
4. Bind fixed_support_risk.py, new entry point, scoring-config.json and the fixed historical-risk reporting policy as executing qualified code/assets. The policy explicitly records all3 score series, original strata, participant-primary/pooled-secondary, emitted-scene outcomes, paired multiplicity-preserving bootstrap, missingness/whole-tie/exact-area/common-domain/random-ranking interpretation before gold. Prospective efficacy/resource decisions remain separate.
5. Synthetic disposable-Git tests, meaningful selected mutations, full appropriate Python qualification with actual case/exit counts, exact-commit independent review and source/evidence receipts pass. No heavy build alongside active capture62320. No real payload access, main movement, push or publication under this child. Source changes on task branch only; preserve both failed historical attempts.

Expected paths: tools/recall-study/historical_support.py, historical-risk-config.json, study_exposure.py; tests/test_historical_support.py and test_study_exposure.py; evidence under decision-confidence-20261015/historical-support/. Readout arithmetic/actual support declaration and gold execution are later independently qualified actions, not implied by this child.
set.title: [instrument] Guard all-participant historical gold-support freeze
